items.statement: Let E be a finite-dimensional real Hilbert space with its Borel structure, including rank zero. Let V be globally C2 and 0<alpha<=beta, with alpha norm(a)^2<=D²V(x)[a,a]<=beta norm(a)^2 for every x,a. For eta>0 with beta*eta<=1, form the literal normalized volume tilt mu and true Gaussian augmentation J. There exist Markov R and S with R a regular conditional kernel of swapped J, S(y) the reflection x->2x-y of R(y), and every-y explicit normalized reflected density. For every globally smooth compactly supported f, the true conditional mean T f(y)=integral f dS(y) is differentiable at every y and norm(gradient T f(y))²<=(1/eta-alpha)²/[4(alpha+1/eta)]*Var_{S(y)}(f). The probability laws, differentiability and integrability domains are internally produced. No kernel equality, covariance, Poincare or desired-bound certificate is a public premise.
assumptions: Finite real Hilbert/Borel E including rank zero; finite-Hilbert/rank0 extension is explicitly authored.
Globally C2 V; 0<alpha<=beta and genuine evaluated Hessian bounds alpha||a||²<=D²V(x)[a,a]<=beta||a||² for every x,a.
eta>0 and beta*eta<=1, exact printed source step cap.
Observations are globally smooth and compactly supported. Every-y true Markov conditional laws, actual differentiability and centered L2 domains are outputs.
